description: This Java class 'RecentCommands' manages a UI component that displays and handles a list of recently used commands, including adding, displaying as buttons, persisting, and executing commands within a GUI application.

classes.name: RecentCommands
classes.description: Manages a GUI component for displaying and interacting with a list of recent commands, including persistence and execution.

classes.name: RecentCommands.Entry
classes.description: Represents a command entry in the recent commands list, implements comparison and equality based on command string.

methods.name: RecentCommands
methods.description: Constructor initializing the recent commands list, loading from config or default commands.

methods.name: unpack
methods.description: Loads commands from a serialized string into the recent commands list.

methods.name: addDefaults
methods.description: Adds a predefined set of default commands to the recent commands list.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a command to the recent commands list and updates the UI and configuration.

methods.name: createButton
methods.description: Creates a JButton for a command, with icon and action to execute the command.

methods.name: getContent
methods.description: Returns the GUI component containing the recent commands UI.

methods.name: pack
methods.description: Serializes the recent commands list into a string for storage.

methods.name: getRecent
methods.description: Retrieves a recent command by index, with index 0 being the most recent.
